docs.title: Managing model data in your app

hints: Only properties read inside the tracking closure are observed.
Read just `model.items.count`; keep an `armed` flag and re-install only after `onChange` fires.
Changing `coupon` or an `@ObservationIgnored` property doesn't fire.
jsBridge: `@Observable` tracks **which properties `body` actually reads** and only re-renders for those, like MobX or Vue reactivity, and finer-grained than React's `useState`, which re-renders the component on any update.

compass.q: MobX/Vue track property access during render. How does `@Observable` do the same (the macro plus `withObservationTracking`)?
